access.spacingHint: Mipata yokulirapo pakati pa mizere ndi zowongolera.
access.title: Kuwerenga ndi kupezeka kwa onse

guest.line1: Mukusewera ngati mlendo — zomwe mwapita patsogolo zisungidwa mu msakatuli uyu.
language.coverage: Menyu ndi mawu ofotokozera machesi zamasuliridwa. Zina mwa zomwe zili mu gawo la ntchito zimagwiritsa ntchito chilankhulo china.
language.hint: Sakani pogwiritsa ntchito dzina lachibadwidwe, dzina lomasuliridwa kapena khodi ya chilankhulo.
narration.hint: Tsatirani zochitika zonse zofunika pogwiritsa ntchito mawu, mawu olembedwa kapena zonse ziwiri.
narration.paused: Ndemanga zaimitsidwa kaye limodzi ndi machesi
narration.title: Ndemanga ndi mawu olembedwa
narration.unavailable: Palibe mawu a msakatuli m'chinenerochi. Mawu olembedwa akupezekabe.
nav.searchHint: Lembani dzina la gawo, kenako lisankheni kuti mupiteko.
quick.description: Sankhani timu yanu ndi wotsutsana naye. Kompyuta idzayendetsa mbali inayo. Ntchito yanu sidzasintha.
quick.hint: Masewero aposachedwa, kulimba kwa osewera ndi njira zamasewera zimakhudzanso zotsatira.
quick.title: Machesi ofulumira
screen.noCareerHint: Sankhani kilabu, pangani gulu lanu ndipo yambani nyengo.
shortcuts.hint: Gwiritsani ntchito kiyibodi poyenda ndi kuwongolera machesi.
shortcuts.title: Njira zazifupi za kiyibodi
studio.cameraHint: Kokani kuti mutembenuze, kapena gwiritsani ntchito mabatani a kamera. Zonse zimagwira ntchito ndi kiyibodi.
studio.clothHint: Yerekezani mmene yunifolomu yatsatanetsatane imayendera pothamanga, potembenuka ndi potera.
studio.phaseHint: Imitsani pa chithunzi chilichonse kuti muyang'ane mmene wosewera akuchirikizira thupi ndi kukhudzana.
studio.position: Maonekedwe a thupi malinga ndi udindo
studio.title: Tsatanetsatane aliyense wa wosewerayu.
studio.webgl: Chithunzithunzi cha 3D chimafuna msakatuli wokhala ndi WebGL.
